title: Identification of small-molecule inhibitors of the DNA repair proteins RuvAB from Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
authors: Dai, Lin; Lu, Lian; Zhang, Xu; Wu, Juhong; Li, Jinyu; Lin, Zhonghui
one_liner_zh: 该文通过高通量筛选和分子对接鉴定靶向细菌RuvAB的DNA修复小分子抑制剂，涉及蛋白-DNA互作（RuvA-HJ DNA）但非TF-DNA体系，方法以实验为主、分子对接为辅，对TF-DNA互作建模有有限借鉴。
abstract: The Holliday junction (HJ) branch migrator RuvAB complex plays a fundamental role during homologous recombination and DNA damage repair, and therefore, is an attractive target for the treatment of bacterial pathogens. Pseudomonas aeruginosa (P. aeruginosa, Pa) is one of the most common clinical opportunistic bacterial pathogens, which can cause a series of life-threatening acute or chronic infections. Here, we performed a high throughput small-molecule screening targeting PaRuvAB using the FRET-based HJ branch migration assay. We identified that corilagin, bardoxolone methyl (BM) and 10-(6'-plastoquinonyl) decyltriphenylphosphonium (SKQ1) could efficiently inhibit the branch migration activity of PaRuvAB, with IC(50) values of 0.40 +/- 0.04 muM, 0.38 +/- 0.05 muM and 4.64 +/- 0.27 muM, respectively. Further biochemical and molecular docking analyses demonstrated that corilagin directly bound to PaRuvB at the ATPase domain, and thus prevented ATP hydrolysis. In contrast, BM and SKQ1 acted through blocking the interactions between PaRuvA and HJ DNA. Finally, these compounds were shown to increase the susceptibility of P. aeruginosa to UV-C irradiation. Our work, for the first time, reports the small-molecule inhibitors of RuvA and RuvB from any species, providing valuable chemical tools to dissect the functional role of each individual protein in vivo.
abstract_zh: Holliday 连接（HJ）分支迁移器 RuvAB 复合物在同源重组和 DNA 损伤修复中发挥基础作用，因此是治疗细菌病原体的有吸引力的靶点。铜绿假单胞菌（P. aeruginosa, Pa）是最常见的临床机会性细菌病原体之一，可引发一系列危及生命的急性或慢性感染。在此，我们利用基于 FRET 的 HJ 分支迁移实验，针对 PaRuvAB 进行了高通量小分子筛选。我们鉴定出 corilagin、bardoxolone methyl (BM) 和 10-(6'-plastoquinonyl) decyltriphenylphosphonium (SKQ1) 能有效抑制 PaRuvAB 的分支迁移活性，其 IC(50) 值分别为 0.40 ± 0.04 μM、0.38 ± 0.05 μM 和 4.64 ± 0.27 μM。进一步的生化和分子对接分析表明，corilagin 直接结合到 PaRuvB 的 ATPase 结构域，从而阻止 ATP 水解。相比之下，BM 和 SKQ1 通过阻断 PaRuvA 与 HJ DNA 之间的相互作用发挥作用。最后，这些化合物被证明能增加铜绿假单胞菌对 UV-C 照射的敏感性。我们的工作首次报道了来自任何物种的 RuvA 和 RuvB 的小分子抑制剂，为在体内剖析每个单独蛋白的功能角色提供了宝贵的化学工具。
